sourceTitle: Changing the schedule: clashes, grouping and gaps
observedAudience: Owners and office staff who schedule, dispatch and record field jobs. No developer knowledge is needed.
observedLearningOutcomes: Explain what a schedule clash is and what the app shows when one occurs.
Choose a safe default for a clash that cannot be fixed automatically.
Use grouping and gap filling to reduce travel without breaking customer windows.
